description_en: Sets the auto-renewal status for a subscription PolarDB cluster
description_zh: 设置PolarDB包年包月集群自动续费状态
name: ModifyAutoRenewAttribute

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the database clusters. The clusters must use the subscription billing method. If you call this operation for a pay-as-you-go cluster, the OperationDenied.DBClusterPayType error may be returned. You can call the TransformDBClusterPayType operation to change the billing method first
parameters.help_zh: 数据库集群 ID。集群付费类型须为包年包月（Prepaid）；按量付费集群调用可能返回 OperationDenied.DBClusterPayType。可先调用 TransformDBClusterPayType 转换付费类型
parameters.name: db_cluster_ids

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. The value can be up to 50 characters in length.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319134.html operation to query available regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID，长度不超过50个字符。

可通过接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2319134.html查看可用的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Sets the auto-renewal status. Valid values: 

AutoRenewal: auto-renewal
Normal: manual renewal 
NotRenewal: no renewal 

Default value: AutoRenewal. 

If you set this parameter to NotRenewal, the system no longer sends expiration reminders and only sends a non-renewal reminder three days before expiration
parameters.help_zh:
设置自动续费状态，取值范围如下： 

AutoRenewal：自动续费。
Normal：手动续费。 
NotRenewal：不再续费。 

默认为AutoRenewal。 

设置为NotRenewal后，系统不再发送到期提醒，只在到期前第三天发送不续费提醒
parameters.name: renewal_status

parameters.help_en:
Sets the auto-renewal duration for the instance. Valid values: 

When PeriodUnit is set to Month, valid values are `[1,2,3,6,12]`.
When PeriodUnit is set to Year, valid values are `[1-3]`.
 
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
设置实例自动续费时长，取值范围如下： 

当PeriodUnit为Month时，取值为`[1,2,3,6,12]`。
当PeriodUnit为Year时，取值为`[1-3]`。
 
默认为1
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the renewal duration. Valid values: 

Year: year
Month: month
 
Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
续费时长的单位，取值范围如下： 

Year：年。
Month：月。
 
默认为Month。
parameters.name: period_unit

parameters.help_en: The cloud provider of the instance
parameters.name: cloud_provider
